name: Modal Overlay Recovery
description: Detect and dismiss blocking overlays (modals, banners, popups, cookie consents) one at a time by clicking their close buttons, re-grounding after each dismissal before proceeding to the underlying task.
notes: Click the overlay's close/dismiss/accept/X button directly — do not use dismiss_overlays.
Dismiss one overlay at a time, re-read after each to verify it is gone.
Do not call done until ALL blocking overlays are confirmed gone.
